He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Northwest Florida State College#Athletics|Northwest Florida State Raiders]] and the [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|NC State Wolfpack]]. He has also participated in the [[NBA Summer League]] with the [[Utah Jazz]].{{cite web |last=Treasure |first=Angie |date=July 2, 2022 |title=Jazz Announce 2022 Summer League Roster |url=https://www.nba.com/jazz/news/jazz-announce-2022-summer-league-roster |access-date=July 5, 2022 |publisher=NBA}} == High school career == Funderburk attended [[St. Edward High School (Ohio)|St. Edward High School]]. As a junior, he averaged 14.2 points and 6.7 rebounds per game to help lead St. Edwards to the 2015 Division I State Final Four.{{cite web |title=NC State basketball signs junior college post Derek Funderburk |url=https://ncstate.rivals.com/news/nc-state-basketball-signs-junior-college-post-derek-funderburk/ |website=[[Rivals.com]] |access-date=August 28, 2021 |date=November 14, 2017}} He transferred to [[Hargrave Military Academy]] for his senior season, playing under coach [[A. W. Hamilton]] and alongside future NC State teammate Braxton Beverly. Funderburk averaged 18 points, nine rebounds and three assists per game and helped the Tigers to a Prep School National Championship and a 47–1 record. Funderburk was ranked the No. 77 overall recruit in the class of 2016. He committed to [[Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball|Ohio State]]. == College career == Funderburk [[redshirted]] his freshman season at Ohio State. He transferred to [[Northwest Florida State College#Athletics|Northwest Florida State College]] and averaged 11.5 points, 5.0 rebounds and 1.7 assists per game as a redshirt freshman, shooting 51.1 percent from the field. Funderburk transferred to [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|NC State]].{{cite web |last=Zembal |first=Jacey |title=DJ Funderburk's journey leads him to NC State |url=https://ncstate.rivals.com/news/dj-funderburk-s-journey-leads-him-to-nc-state-wolfpack-basketball/ |website=[[Rivals.com]] |access-date=August 28, 2021 |date=October 19, 2018}} Funderburk averaged 8.8 points and 4.2 rebounds per game as a redshirt sophomore. He was suspended for violating team policy in September 2019.{{cite news |date=September 30, 2019 |title=DJ Funderburk suspended for breaking NC State Wolfpack policy |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/27739365 |access-date=August 28, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]]}} Funderburk was charged with larceny property damage by university police after driving off with two [[Wheel clamp|car boots]], damaging the boots and the concrete surface in the parking lot.{{cite news |last=Giglio |first=Joe |title=N.C. State's Funderburk involved in parking incident before his suspension |url=https://greensboro.com/n-c-states-funderburk-involved-in-parking-incident-before-his-suspension/article_e8cb4f03-c1b1-5706-b1f0-c26f4e7f53dd.html |access-date=August 28, 2021 |work=[[The News & Observer]] |date=October 10, 2019}} On December 29, 2019, he scored a career-high 22 points in a 72–60 win against [[2019–20 Appalachian State Mountaineers men's basketball team|Appalachian State]].{{cite news |title=Funderburk, Daniels spark Wolfpack win in Bryce's absence |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401168623 |access-date=August 28, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=December 29, 2019}} As a redshirt junior, Funderburk averaged 12.8 points and 6.1 rebounds per game. Following the season, he declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]], but ultimately opted to return to NC State.{{cite web |last=Williams |first=Justin |title=DJ Funderburk officially returns to NC State |url=https://ncstate.rivals.com/news/d-j-funderburk-officially-returning-to-nc-state |website=[[Rivals.com]] |access-date=August 28, 2021 |date=July 31, 2020}} Funderburk missed a game against [[2020–21 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] on January 31, 2021, due to a violation of university policy.{{cite web |last=Carter |first=Matt |title=What they're saying about NC State basketball's loss at Syracuse |url=https://ncstate.rivals.com/news/what-they-re-saying-about-nc-state-basketball-s-loss-at-syracuse |website=[[Rivals.com]] |access-date=August 28, 2021 |date=February 1, 2021}} As a senior, he averaged 12.6 points and 5.6 rebounds per game.{{cite news |last=Alexander |first=Jonathan |title=Hornets invite NC State's Funderburk for pre-draft workout |url=https://www.charlotteobserver.com/sports/charlotte-hornets/article252628033.html |access-date=August 28, 2021 |work=[[Charlotte Observer]] |date=July 7, 2021}} Following the season, Funderburk declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]] and signed with an agent, forgoing the additional season of eligibility the NCAA granted due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web |last=Williams |first=Justin |title=DJ Funderburk signs with Athletes Sports Management, ending NC State career |url=https://ncstate.rivals.com/news/dj-funderburk-signs-with-athletes-sports-management-ending-nc-state-career |website=[[Rivals.com]] |access-date=August 28, 2021 |date=April 27, 2021}} == Professional career == After going undrafted in the [[2021 NBA draft]], Funderburk signed with the [[Utah Jazz]] for Summer League play.{{cite news |last=Smith |first=R. Cory |title=DJ Funderburk set to join Utah Jazz in NBA Summer League |url=https://247sports.com/college/north-carolina-state/Article/DJ-Funderburk-Utah-Jazz-NBA-Summer-League-NC-State-basketball-168527440/ |access-date=August 28, 2021 |work=247 Sports |date=July 31, 2021}} On August 27, 2021, Funderburk signed his first professional contract with the Russian team [[BC Avtodor|Avtodor]] of the [[VTB United League]].{{cite web |last=Yahyabeyoglu |first=Fersu |title=DJ Funderburk joins Avtodor |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Russia/news/702278/DJ-Funderburk-joins-Avtodor |website=Eurobasket |access-date=August 28, 2021 |date=August 27, 2021}} He left the team after the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]].{{Cite web|url=https://basketnews.com/news-167600-leave-or-stay-american-players-in-russia.html|title=Leave or stay: American players in Russia|website=basketnews.com}} Funderburk averaged 10.7 points and 2.6 rebounds per game. On March 16, 2022, Funderburk signed with [[Paris Basketball]] of the [[LNB Pro A]] for the rest of the season.{{Cite web|url=https://parisbasketball.paris/2022/03/le-paris-basketball-recrute-dj-funderburk/#|title=Le Paris Basketball recrute DJ Funderburk|last=|first=|date=March 16, 2022|website=parisbasketball.paris|publisher=|language=fr|access-date=March 16, 2022}} On July 12, 2022, Funderburk signed with [[Promitheas Patras B.C.|Promitheas Patras]] of the [[Greek Basket League]] and the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]].{{Cite web |title=Προμηθέας Πάτρας - "Πατρινός" ο D.J Funderburk |url=https://www.promitheasbc.gr/index.php/nea/andriko/4160-dj-funderburk-welcome |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220712094236/https://www.promitheasbc.gr/index.php/nea/andriko/4160-dj-funderburk-welcome |archive-date=2022-07-12 |access-date=2022-07-12 |website=promitheasbc.gr |language=el}} On September 3, 2022, Funderburk mutually parted ways with the Greek club without appearing in a single official game with the team.{{Cite web |title=ΑΝΑΚΟΊΝΩΣΗ ΚΑΕ ΠΡΟΜΗΘΈΑ |url=https://www.promitheasbc.gr/index.php/nea/andriko/4191-anakoinosi-kae-promithea-funderburk |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220903183403/https://www.promitheasbc.gr/index.php/nea/andriko/4191-anakoinosi-kae-promithea-funderburk |archive-date=2022-09-03 |access-date=2022-09-03 |website=promitheasbc.gr |language=el}} On the same day, he signed with [[Pallacanestro Reggiana|Reggio Emilia]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA).{{Cite web |last=Carchia |first=Emiliano |date=September 3, 2022 |title=DJ Funderburk joins Pallacanestro Reggiana |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/dj-funderburk-joins-pallacanestro-reggiana/ |access-date=September 3, 2022 |website= |publisher=Sportando |language=en}} On November 14, 2022, he signed with [[Hapoel Eilat B.C.|Hapoel Eilat]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/d-j-funderburk-et-manu-lecomte-ensemble-a-lhapoel-eilat/|title=D.J. Funderburk et Manu Lecomte ensemble à l’Hapoel Eilat|last=|first=|date=November 14, 2022|website=bebasket.fr|publisher=|language=fr|access-date=January 29, 2023}} On July 28, 2024, he signed with [[KK Włocławek|Anwil Włocławek]] of the [[Polish Basketball League]] (PLK).{{cite web |title=Anwil lands DJ Funderburk ex Split |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Poland/news/884273/Anwil-lands-DJ-Funderburk-ex-Split |website=Eurobasket |access-date=August 8, 2024 |date=July 28, 2024}} On June 26, 2025, Funderburk signed a one-year contract with [[G.S. Iraklis Thessaloniki (men's basketball)|Iraklis]] of the [[Greek Basketball League]].{{Cite web |date=2025-06-26 |title=Στον Ηρακλή ο D. J. Funderburk |url=https://iraklis-bc.gr/%cf%83%cf%84%ce%bf%ce%bd-%ce%b7%cf%81%ce%b1%ce%ba%ce%bb%ce%ae-%ce%bf-d-j-funderburk/ |access-date=2025-08-06 |website=iraklis-bc.gr |language=el}} On July 11, 2026, Funderburk signed with [[Mykonos B.C.|Mykonos BC]] of the [[Greek Basketball League]].{{cite web |last1=Papadopoulos |first1=Kostas |title=Mykonos add Funderburk to their roster
